candidate_text: Complete every field on the need-based scholarship application form, including a detailed explanation in the petition section of why you are applying; incomplete applications may be returned for correction.
gold_reason: Imperative instruction requiring students to complete all form fields with a specific consequence for non-compliance.

candidate_text: Do not submit pharmaceutical/drug research applications to the Istanbul Bilgi University Ethics Committee; the committee does not evaluate such applications.
gold_reason: Text defines committee scope and provides procedural information rather than assigning a concrete duty.

candidate_text: After completing freshman courses, apply for the University of London Honor Programme through the Faculty of Business if you meet their criteria — admission is based on exam and interview results, and enrollment starts from the second year.
gold_reason: The text describes an optional application pathway for eligible students rather than a mandatory duty.

candidate_text: Prepare and upload the required supporting documents with your need-based scholarship application, including at minimum a detailed family civil registry record (vukuatlı nüfus cüzdanı örneği) obtained via e-Government showing the full family, plus any applicable health reports, pension documents, payroll slips, loan payment statements, enforcement/bankruptcy records, or death certificates.
gold_reason: The text imposes a concrete duty on the student to prepare and upload specific documents as part of the scholarship application process.

candidate_text: If you cannot graduate because you failed a single course or your GPA is below 2.00, check whether you qualify for a supplementary exam: (a) if your GPA would reach 2.00 by passing the single failed course, you are granted a supplementary exam for that course; (b) if you passed all courses but your GPA is below 2.00, you may take an exam in a course of your choice on the condition it raises your GPA to 2.00 or above. If you fail the supplementary exam or cannot raise your GPA, you must follow course-repeat rules.
gold_reason: The text explicitly mandates students to follow course-repeat rules under specific failure conditions.

candidate_text: During an exam, if an invigilator asks to check your phone and you refuse, a report will be prepared and your refusal may be used as evidence of cheating.
gold_reason: Text describes consequences of non-compliance rather than explicitly assigning a mandatory duty.

candidate_text: Submit requests, suggestions, or complaints through your SIS page via BİLGİ Line, and follow up on responses there.
gold_reason: Imperative instruction mandates a specific communication channel and follow-up procedure for students.

candidate_text: Renew your need-based scholarship application each year with updated documents if your financial need continues; the scholarship does not automatically carry over.
gold_reason: Contains clear action verb 'Renew' with annual deadline and condition for the student role.

candidate_text: Do not rely on your need-based scholarship to cover summer school; plan summer funding separately.
gold_reason: It is advisory guidance regarding scholarship coverage limitations rather than a mandatory regulatory duty.

candidate_text: If the Ethics Committee rejects your research application with a revision-and-resubmission recommendation, address every specific correction listed in the decision before resubmitting; your research cannot proceed until you obtain a positive decision.
gold_reason: Imposes a concrete duty on the applicant to address specific corrections before resubmission.

candidate_text: Monitor your GPA each semester during your double major: if your overall GPA falls below 2.60 twice or your secondary major GPA falls below 2.00 twice, you will be disenrolled from the secondary major program.
gold_reason: The text explicitly commands the student to perform a specific action (monitor) with a defined frequency (each semester).

candidate_text: Follow all announcements and updates posted on BİLGİ Learn; course materials, assignments, and synchronous lesson links are shared through this platform.
gold_reason: It mandates the student to monitor a specific platform for course information.
